messages:
Ellen: Auditor asked for KMS rotation chain-of-custody + RBAC drift for last 90 days. Need a compact bundle and a short narrative per rotation. COB today.
Ravi: We can assemble CloudTrail CSV for CreateKey/RotateKey/UpdateKeyPolicy/CreateGrant, git diffs for infra/kms-policies, IAM role-policy snapshots filtered for kms:Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, and IRSA mapping CSV.
Auditor_Liaison: Machine-readable preferred. For each rotation we need timestamp, approver (pseudonym ok), triggering ticket, and post-rotation verification (smoke decrypt logs). Also grant lifecycle (grantId/create/delete times). No key material.
Ellen: Plan: 1) cloudtrail_rotate_90d.csv 2) kms-policy-commits.log + policy-diff.patch 3) roles_kms_snapshot.csv 4) irsa_map.csv 5) grants.csv 6) manifest.csv with sha256 + redaction flag + short narrative entries.
Ravi: CLI snippets: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2027-03-01T00:00:00Z --output json > cloudtrail_rotate_90d.json
kubectl get sa --all-namespaces -o json | jq -r '.items[] | [.metadata.namespace, .metadata.name, .metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"]] | @csv' > irsa_map.csv
```
Ravi: Note: emergency rotation on 2027-02-14 for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:555666777:key/emerg-2027 after vulnerability triage CVE-2027-2424 (ticket SEC-742). Include TICKET-742 and smoke_decrypt_20270214.log.
Ellen: Manifest CSV format: artifact_type,source,timestamp,evidence_file,sha256,redacted,narrative_id
Sample row: 
"artifact_type,source,timestamp,evidence_file,sha256,redacted,narrative_id
cloudtrail,aws,2027-02-14T16:02:11Z,cloudtrail_rotate_20270214.json,d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e,false,rot-20270214"
Auditor_Liaison: Fine. Replace human emails with employee:<id> in artifacts and send identity_map via secure SFTP. We may request a short walkthrough on IRSA mapping for one service.
ops_bot: evidence-bundle-1766667000 queued. ETA ~5m. :package: 
Ravi: I'll add redaction_map.csv and a short SOP excerpt pointing to docs/security/kms-rotation.md that shows approver roles and approval recording (JIRA comment).
ops_bot: evidence-bundle-1766667000 completed: https://s3.internal.company/evidence/1766667000_kmsrbac.tar.gz :lock: sha256: 3a7bd3e2360a3f9d1f3e6a7c9b2d4f5e
Ellen: Drafting auditor response with bundle link, manifest, and SFTP instructions for identity map. Will flag SEC-742 and attach smoke test logs. Anyone object to including full role ARNs?
Auditor_Liaison: Role ARNs OK. Please pseudonymize human identifiers. We may ask for attestations for any redactions.
Ravi: Uploaded roles_kms_snapshot.csv, irsa_map.csv, grants.csv, policy-diff.patch, and smoke_decrypt_20270214.log to the bundle.
Ellen: Thanks team. Will follow up if auditor requests an IRSA walkthrough. Closing when auditor confirms receipt. :white_check_mark:
